_doc: Survival tuning. Rates are per GAME hour unless noted (stamina: per real second; regen_delay_melee: the shorter wait after a swing, so steady chopping regains some (a stone axe fells a fir in ~7-11 swings without emptying the bar); bleeding: per game minute). Infection below dormant_below is fought off (one or two bites fade); above it the Bloom grows until treated.

temperature._cold_damage: Below hypothermia the cold hurts by how deep the body has gone: cold_damage_per_hour x (degrees below / cold_damage_full_below), at least cold_damage_min_frac of it. First-week audit W7: the full 8/h began the moment the body crossed 35.0, so an ordinary overcast autumn night in starting gear (body settles at ~34.7) cost a player without food regen 44 health, and a rainy night killed one outright. Now: overcast ~11, steady rain or a storm (body ~32-33, full rate) still kills an unfed player left out in it from dusk to the next noon (8:00 before), and a fed one keeps 75+.

warnings._doc: SurvivalWarnings: one ladder per need. A line as the stat falls below each level (in order, each once, even when it drops past several at once); while it lasts the current one again only once the stat has fallen a further worse_by since the last line, or after repeat_minutes of game time (a level's own repeat_minutes overrides the ladder's: the deepest waits longer), whichever is first (mid-game audit M7: 'freezing' every 90 min all night at a steady body temperature); reset once the stat is back above reset_above. Cold: at 1.4 C/h a soaked player hears the first ~35 game minutes in and the second ~20 before the cold starts to hurt (hypothermia 35.0). Thirst (6/h): from full, 'thirsty' ~10.8 h in (health stopped mending at 40), 'parched' ~14.2 h in, harm at 16.7 h. Hunger (4/h): 'hungry' ~17.5 h in, 'starving' ~22.5 h in, harm at 25 h. First-week audit W7, W18, W19.
